title: Name Tag Craft
description: This Datapack adds name tag craft for 1.21.11 and below not for 26.1 and higher. Craft name tags have already been added in 26.1
body:
This datapack adds Name Tag Craft for 1.21.11 and below **(for users 26.1 and higher сraft tags have already been added in 26.1 and higher)**
### How to use:
1. Download the zip file
2. Put it into your "datapacks" folder inside your world save.
3. Use the /reload command or restart your world.
4. Enjoy! How to craft in Photos:
